identity.title: Transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation before surgery reduces chronic pain after mastectomy: A randomized clinical trial

denominator_evidence: PDF p3 Figure 1 visually inspected: ITT 188/198/190, PP 184/196/188; four changed surgery, four follow-up losses.

results.chronic_note: p5 Table 2 NRS denominator is ONLY patients with chronic pain, not entire randomized arms.

analgesia.drug: Sufentanil postoperative PCA, unreported total; remifentanil IV intraoperative only
analgesia.rescue: Parecoxib sodium 40 mg when NRS >4; nonopioid

opioid_decision: Excluded from postoperative opioid synthesis; Table 3 title does not change intraoperative remifentanil window explicitly defined in §2.5.
source_conflicts: p4 text uses 79/196 single-arm chronic pain versus Table 2 and abstract 72/198; p4 pain P-values disagree with Table 3; no uncritical adoption of narrative.
PONV composite counts do not equal nausea plus vomiting; preserve published subtypes separately.

rob_independent.randomization: Low: secured centralized web system stratified center, randomly varying blocks; p2 §2.3 and Table 1.
rob_independent.deviations: Low: participant and interventionist unmasked, other clinical staff masked, monitored protocol with ITT; no evidence of trial-context nonprotocol cointervention; p2 §§2.1–2.6, p3 §2.7.
rob_independent.missing: Low for short-term common outcomes: nearly all followed; Table 3 ITT; precise short-term observed versus imputed n not separately reported.
rob_independent.measurement: Some concerns for self-reported pain/nausea/composite: participants explicitly not masked, hence own assessors aware; could influence responses but actual influence not demonstrated. Low for blinded record-based intraoperative opioid and overt vomiting.
rob_independent.selection: Some concerns: prospective registration stated April 2016, but dated detailed analysis plan not yet obtained. 5.1 NI;5.2 NI;5.3 NI. All short-term outcomes reported but cannot demonstrate prospective analysis choices.

independence: Single trial with two active arms sharing one sham; do not independently double-count shared control.
missing_outcomes: Postoperative opioid quantity, QoR15/QoR40, GI: Insufficient information / not reported.
